This is only partially resolved with https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-audit/pull/6

The PR adds the relevant test gear to make it possible to write integration tests. I probably won't have time to finish this on Friday/Monday, but this PR should get you much of the way there.
Re-opening so others know there is more work to be done on this ticket.

I've added a basic IT to Unknown's branch:

https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-audit/compare/fcrepo-1481

But even though I see a repository configuration that looks pretty much like the http-api's, and I see startup messages, etc., there doesn't seem to be a REST API running.
This ticket is "In Progress". Former user, are you working it?
